title: ESP32-C3 Adblock
summary: A DIY network-level ad blocker built on ESP32-C3 microcontroller that runs 24/7 with minimal power consumption, blocking ads and trackers at DNS level similar to Pi-hole but in a tiny, energy-efficient embedded device costing only a few dollars.
problem_solved: Provides a low-cost, ultra-low-power alternative to running a dedicated server for network-wide ad blocking.
why_valuable: Enables continuous ad blocking with minimal electricity cost (microamps in deep sleep), compact size, and under $5 hardware investment.
